name: Tortilla Mexican Grill plc
summary: Tortilla Mexican Grill PLC oversees the running of its Mexican eateries, all trading under the 'Tortilla' name. Its operations span the United Kingdom, where it manages 51 company-owned locations and three franchised outlets, as well as the Middle East, hosting an additional ten franchised establishments. This enterprise was established in 2007 and is based in London, UK.
